systems.country_label: Tchad Connexion 2030 - Plan National de Développement
systems.owner: Ministère des Finances, du Budget, de l'Economie, du Plan et de la Coopération Internationale
systems.tiers: national; 2025-2030; US$30bn, 17 programmes and 268 projects and reforms in four intervention domains; presidential preface signed N'Djamena 29 May 2025

note: Class development-plan, a systems entry and no fact. The text calls itself 'Plan National de Développement', 'Plan de Développement' and 'un plan stratégique sans précédent', covering water, electricity, digital, transport, education, health, agriculture, mining, tourism, justice, tax and more in 17 programmes (digital is Programme n°3 'Economie numérique', one of 17). It names no separate national digital strategy: for the digital programme it lists the reform 'Mettre à jour la stratégie sectorielle afin de sécuriser les réformes envisagées' (an unnamed existing sector strategy, no date or standing) and the annex lists only digital projects and reforms (R9-R11, P15-P22); it also cites the earlier 'PND Tchad 2017-2021' and 'PND 2024-2028' as national development plans.
